question: The Ancient Indian Epic '________' Stands as the longest epic poem known, and has been described as 'the longest poem ever written'.
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Mahabharata**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **The Mahabharata** is an ancient Indian epic that is considered the longest epic poem in history.
 
• It is attributed to the sage Vyasa and contains approximately 100,000 shlokas or over 200,000 individual verse lines.
 
• The epic is divided into 18 Parvas or books, with an additional supplement called Harivamsa Parva.
 
• It narrates the story of the Kurukshetra War and the fates of the Kaurava and the Pandava princes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Ramayana:**

 
 
• The Ramayana is another ancient Indian epic, attributed to the sage Valmiki.
 
• It narrates the life of Prince Rama, his wife Sita, and his loyal companion Hanuman.
 
• The epic consists of 24,000 verses divided into seven Kandas (books).
 
• The Ramayana is a key text in Hindu literature and culture.
 
 
 
• **The Bhagawad Gita:**
 
 
• The Bhagawad Gita is a 700-verse Hindu scripture that is part of the Indian epic Mahabharata.
 
• It is a sacred text of the Hindu religion and is in the form of a dialogue between Prince Arjuna and the god Krishna, who serves as his charioteer.
 
• The Gita addresses the moral and philosophical dilemmas faced by Arjuna on the battlefield of Kurukshetra.
 
 
 
• **The Buddhacharita:**
 
 
• The Buddhacharita is an epic poem by Ashvaghosha, which details the life of Gautama Buddha.
 
• It was composed in the early 2nd century CE and is one of the earliest works on the life of Buddha.
 
• The poem is written in classical Sanskrit and is divided into 28 chapters.
